title: Fewer contacts slow an infected stock
hook: Two stated cases for fewer contacts slow an infected stock.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the contact-rate parameter before computing a complete epidemic peak affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines NextI, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the contact-rate parameter before computing a complete epidemic peak in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
